what_we_see_outside: Most breaches in the region start with phishing, stolen credentials or application exploits
why: Vendor support accounts sit outside the access review
action: Phishing-resistant MFA for all admins; vendor accounts into the review

what_we_see_outside: Attackers take over identity first, then steal, encrypt or destroy data and backups
why: Core banking backups not yet isolated; no full restore test this year
action: Isolated backups and a full restore test in Q1 2027

what_we_see_outside: Attacks last longer and combine several techniques at once
why: Payments gateway relies on the vendor's protection, never tested jointly
action: Joint DDoS test with Vendor X

what_we_see_outside: Attackers use AI agents to run intrusions (the fastest reach impact in under 40 hours) and cloned voices or faked video calls to push payments and password resets
why: Containment takes 7 hours on median; cloud logs only partly monitored; the help desk can reset a password on a voice call; two AI agent pilots run with standing privileged access
action: Automated containment playbooks; full cloud log coverage; call-back on a known number for payment changes and resets; one scoped identity per AI agent

what_we_see_outside: Attackers reach banks through shared providers and software
why: Two critical providers have no security attestation this year
action: Obtain attestations; add to contract reviews

what_we_see_outside: Data stolen today could be decrypted later; planning has started across the region
why: No inventory yet of where cryptography is used
